sell.heroTitle: Start with a number, not a phone call.
sell.heroBody: Answer four questions and see an estimated range for your home in about a minute. Talk to an advisor only if you want to.
sell.q0: Let's put a number on your home. What's the address, or the neighborhood?
sell.q1: Thanks. Roughly how many square feet is the interior?
sell.q2: And the lot? A rough number is fine — skip it if you're not sure.
sell.q4: Last one. How would you describe the condition?
sell.q5: What kind of home is it?
sell.resultLead: Based on what you've told me, here's my estimated range:
sell.ctaTitle: Get your exact valuation from an agent
sell.ctaBody: An estimate is a starting point. A valuation uses comparable sales, your finishes and the current buyer pool — and it is free.
sell.step1Body: Comparable sales, condition and the current buyer pool — not an algorithm.

sell.step3Body: Photography, film, print and a private network before anything goes public.

sell.step5Body: Escrow, inspections and repair negotiation, managed end to end.

sell.service2Body: A film for the home, plus vertical cutdowns for where buyers actually look.

about.title: A smaller list, prepared properly.
about.subtitle: Sol & Stone was founded on a narrow idea: take fewer listings, and prepare each one as though it were the only one.
about.story1: Most brokerages measure themselves in volume. We measure ourselves in preparation — the weeks before a home reaches the market, when the decisions that determine the outcome are actually made.
about.story2: That means we turn down listings we cannot prepare properly, and it means our advisors carry fewer clients than they could. It is a deliberately smaller business, and it is why our homes sell closer to ask and faster than the market around them.
about.story3: We work in English and Spanish across Los Angeles County, from the Bird Streets to Point Dume, and we have done so since 2011.
about.value1Body: The photography can only be as good as the house on the day. We spend our budget earlier than most.
about.value2Body: Off-market when it serves the client, public when it serves the price. Never the other way around.
about.value3Body: We show you the comparable sales we used and the ones we discarded. You should be able to check our work.
about.ctaBody: Buying, selling, or simply working out whether now is the moment — we are happy to be useful before we are hired.

testimonials.t1: They told us not to remodel the kitchen. Every other agent we met told us to. We sold in eleven days, over ask, and I still think about how much that one piece of advice saved us.
testimonials.t2: The 360° tour meant my parents in Madrid could walk the house before we made an offer. That is not a gimmick when you are buying from four thousand miles away.
testimonials.t3: Elena showed us the comparable sales she rejected and why. No one had ever done that. We trusted the number because we could check it.
